name: kimi-k3
description: Kimi K3 is Kimi’s most capable flagship model to date. With 2.8 trillion parameters, it is built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), a hybrid linear attention architecture, and Attention Residuals. The model natively supports visual understanding and features a 1-million-token context window. As the world’s first open-source model in the 3-trillion-parameter class, Kimi K3 is designed for frontier workloads such as long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning.
zhDescription: Kimi K3 是 Kimi 迄今能力最强的旗舰模型，拥有 2.8 万亿参数，基于 KDA 混合线性注意力机制（Kimi Delta Attention）和注意力残差（Attention Residuals）技术构建，原生支持视觉理解，并拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口。它是全球首个开源的 3 万亿级别模型，面向长程编程、知识工作和推理等前沿智能场景而设计。
